top3.whyItMatters: Forecasting is becoming a trainable agent skill; watch which vendors build on it.

top3.headline: Dario Amodei says turning governance over to AI is a terrible idea
top3.whyItMatters: AI autonomy is now a public fight between lab leaders; set your own limits first.

items.title: Perplexity Time Machine shows models the web on any past date
items.takeaway: Perplexity says it lets teams post-train agents to predict the future; live in its Search and Context APIs.
items.soWhat: Forecasting is becoming an agent skill you can train; watch which vendors build on it.

items.title: Theo says T3 Code never uploaded prompts, files or user data
items.takeaway: In a final statement on the telemetry dispute, Theo says T3 Code tracked only token and prompt counts.
items.soWhat: Before rolling out coding tools, get a written list of exactly what telemetry leaves your machines.

items.title: Poteto: find where your coding workflow still needs human review
items.takeaway: Periodically resurface the limiting step that still needs human review, then do the work to let agents drive it.
items.soWhat: Human review is the new bottleneck; schedule regular audits of where your team's agents wait on people.

items.title: Amodei says handing human governance to AI is a terrible idea
items.takeaway: Replying to an Axios article, he says AI must be governed democratically; his views on task automation are mixed.
items.soWhat: Lab leaders now argue openly about AI autonomy; decide where your company wants humans to keep control.

items.title: Meng To: MAGI-2 made a six-shot 1080p scene for 75 credits
items.takeaway: One character drawing and two place photos produced 30 seconds with sound and a consistent character.
items.soWhat: Short branded video is getting cheap enough to prototype in-house before you brief an agency.
